profile.writer: one synchronous interpreter step between native calls

limits: Only one synchronous qword MOV store profile is exercised
Only one physical RAM code page and two fixed aliases are covered
Only committed writes routed through this step_paged_mov call are reconciled
Cross-page data operand behavior and cross-page code are outside this slice
No generic writer notification, remap/TLB invalidation, active-block mutation, DMA or SMP
Existing step_paged_mov may dispatch MMIO, but S4-16b validates RAM only; reconciliation covers committed physical RAM callbacks and does not represent device-side writes
Performance is unmeasured and no speed claim is made
Parent S4-16 and Stage 4 remain open
